_comment: Tier-0 Wood-side gather material. Taken from the rough trunks of the selva's pines. Hell cannot heal -- materials for medicinal preparations are gathered above, never below. Quality varies with how much intact bark the gatherer finds; the lottery lives in the gather node config, not here.
name: Bark scrap
description: A strip torn from a pine. Resin clings to its inner side and sticks to the fingers; the wood beneath is paler than the outer black.
